# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Use a guard clause instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional
      # expression
      #
      # A condition with an `elsif` or `else` branch is allowed unless
      # one of `return`, `break`, `next`, `raise`, or `fail` is used
      # in the body of the conditional expression.
      #
      # NOTE: Autocorrect works in most cases except with if-else statements
      #   that contain logical operators such as `foo || raise('exception')`
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if something
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   def test
      #     return unless something
      #
      #     work
      #   end
      #
      #   # also good
      #   def test
      #     work if something
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if something
      #     raise 'exception'
      #   else
      #     ok
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   raise 'exception' if something
      #   ok
      #
      #   # bad
      #   if something
      #     foo || raise('exception')
      #   else
      #     ok
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo || raise('exception') if something
      #   ok
      #
      #   # bad
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     if something
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # good
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     return unless something
      #
      #     work
      #   end
      #
      #   # also good
      #   define_method(:test) do
      #     work if something
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowConsecutiveConditionals: false (default)
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     if bar?  # <- reports an offense
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      # @example AllowConsecutiveConditionals: true
      #   # good
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     if bar?
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #   def test
      #     if foo?
      #       work
      #     end
      #
      #     do_something
      #
      #     if bar?  # <- reports an offense
      #       work
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      class GuardClause < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include MinBodyLength
        include StatementModifier

        MSG = 'Use a guard clause (`%<example>s`) instead of wrapping the ' \
              'code inside a conditional expression.'

        def on_def(node)
          body = node.body

          return unless body

          check_ending_body(body)
        end
        alias on_defs on_def

        def on_block(node)
          return unless node.method?(:define_method) || node.method?(:define_singleton_method)

          on_def(node)
        end
        alias on_numblock on_block

        def on_if(node)
          remember_conditional_context(node)
          return if accepted_form?(node)

          if (guard_clause = node.if_branch&.guard_clause?)
            kw = node.loc.keyword.source
            guard = :if
          elsif (guard_clause = node.else_branch&.guard_clause?)
            kw = node.inverse_keyword
            guard = :else
          else
            return
          end

          guard = nil if and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)

          register_offense(node, guard_clause_source(guard_clause), kw, guard)
        end

        private

        def check_ending_body(body)
          return if body.nil?

          if body.if_type?
            check_ending_if(body)
          elsif body.begin_type?
            final_expression = body.children.last
            check_ending_if(final_expression) if final_expression&.if_type?
          end
        end

        def check_ending_if(node)
          remember_conditional_context(node)
          return if accepted_form?(node, ending: true) || !min_body_length?(node)
          return if allowed_consecutive_conditionals? &&
                    consecutive_conditionals?(node.parent, node)

          register_offense(node, 'return', node.inverse_keyword)

          check_ending_body(node.if_branch)
        end

        def consecutive_conditionals?(parent, node)
          parent.each_child_node.inject(false) do |if_type, child|
            break if_type if node == child

            child.if_type?
          end
        end

        def register_offense(node, scope_exiting_keyword, conditional_keyword, guard = nil)
          condition, = node.node_parts
          example = [scope_exiting_keyword, conditional_keyword, recalled_conditional_source(node) || condition.source].join(' ')
          if too_long_for_single_line?(node, example)
            return if trivial?(node)

            example = "#{conditional_keyword} #{condition.source}; #{scope_exiting_keyword}; end"
            replacement = <<~RUBY.chomp
              #{conditional_keyword} #{condition.source}
                #{scope_exiting_keyword}
              end
            RUBY
          end

          add_offense(node.loc.keyword, message: format(MSG, example: example)) do |corrector|
            next if node.else? && guard.nil?

            autocorrect(corrector, node, condition, replacement || example, guard)
          end
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def autocorrect(corrector, node, condition, replacement, guard)
          corrector.replace(node.loc.keyword.join(condition.source_range), replacement)

          if_branch = node.if_branch
          else_branch = node.else_branch

          corrector.replace(node.loc.begin, "\n") if node.loc.begin&.is?('then')

          if if_branch&.send_type? && heredoc?(if_branch.last_argument)
            autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, if_branch, else_branch, guard)
          elsif else_branch&.send_type? && heredoc?(else_branch.last_argument)
            autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, else_branch, if_branch, guard)
          else
            corrector.remove(node.loc.end)
            return unless node.else?

            corrector.remove(node.loc.else)
            corrector.remove(range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard))
          end
        end
        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        def heredoc?(argument)
          argument.respond_to?(:heredoc?) && argument.heredoc?
        end

        def autocorrect_heredoc_argument(corrector, node, heredoc_branch, leave_branch, guard)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, node.loc.end)
          return unless node.else?

          remove_whole_lines(corrector, leave_branch.source_range)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, node.loc.else)
          remove_whole_lines(corrector, range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard))
          corrector.insert_after(
            heredoc_branch.last_argument.loc.heredoc_end, "\n#{leave_branch.source}"
          )
        end

        def range_of_branch_to_remove(node, guard)
          branch = case guard
                   when :if then node.if_branch
                   when :else then node.else_branch
                   end

          branch.source_range
        end

        def guard_clause_source(guard_clause)
          if and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)
            guard_clause.parent.source
          else
            guard_clause.source
          end
        end

        def and_or_guard_clause?(guard_clause)
          parent = guard_clause.parent
          parent.and_type? || parent.or_type?
        end

        def too_long_for_single_line?(node, example)
          max = max_line_length
          max && node.source_range.column + example.length > max
        end

        def accepted_form?(node, ending: false)
          accepted_if?(node, ending) || node.condition.multiline? || node.parent&.assignment?
        end

  let(:other_cops) do

    it 'reports an offense if method body is if / unless without else' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        def func
          if something
          ^^ Use a guard clause (`return unless something`) instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional expression.
            #{body}
          end
        end

          ^^^^^^ Use a guard clause (`return if something`) instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional expression.
            #{body}
          end
        end

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        def func
          return unless something
            #{body}

          return if something
            #{body}
         #{trailing_whitespace}
        end
      RUBY
    end

    it 'reports an offense if method body ends with if / unless without else' do

        def func
          test
          if something
          ^^ Use a guard clause (`return unless something`) instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional expression.
            #{body}
          end
        end

            #{body}
          end

        def func
          test
          return unless something
            #{body}
         #{trailing_whitespace}
        end

          test
          return if something
            #{body}
         #{trailing_whitespace}
        end
      RUBY
    end

        define_method(:func) do

            #{body}
          end
        end

        define_method(:func) do
          unless _1
          ^^^^^^ Use a guard clause (`return if _1`) instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional expression.
            #{body}
          end
        end
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        define_method(:func) do
          return unless _1
            #{body}
         #{trailing_whitespace}
        end

        define_method(:func) do
          return if _1
            #{body}
         #{trailing_whitespace}
        end
      RUBY
    end

    it 'reports an offense if `define_singleton_method` block body is if / unless without else' do

        define_singleton_method(:func) do
          if _1
          ^^ Use a guard clause (`return unless _1`) instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional expression.
            #{body}
          end
        end

          unless _1

            #{body}
          end
        end

            #{body}

        end

          return if _1
            #{body}
         #{trailing_whitespace}
        end
      RUBY
    end

            #{body}
          end
        end

          unless something

            #{body}
          end

            #{body}

            node.condition.source

          condition_engine.send(:assignment_facts, condition).any? { |fact| fact[:kind] == :lvasgn }

        def self.single_line_as_modifier_for(cop, node)
          return false if cop.send(:non_eligible_node?, node) ||
                          cop.send(:non_eligible_body?, node.body) ||
                          cop.send(:non_eligible_condition?, node.condition)

          node.modifier_form? ||
            node.nonempty_line_count > 3 ||
            cop.processed_source.line_with_comment?(node.loc.last_line) ||
            (cop.send(:first_line_comment, node) && cop.send(:code_after, node))
        end

        def self.non_eligible_body_for(cop, body)
          body.nil? ||
            body.empty_source? ||
            body.begin_type? ||
            cop.processed_source.contains_comment?(body.source_range)
        end

        def self.non_eligible_condition_for(_cop, condition)
          condition_contains_lvasgn?(condition)
        end

        def self.modifier_fits_on_single_line_for(cop, node)
          return true unless cop.send(:max_line_length)

          cop.send(:length_in_modifier_form, node) <= cop.send(:max_line_length)
        end

        def self.length_in_modifier_form_for(cop, node)
          keyword_element = node.loc.keyword
          code_before = keyword_element.source_line[0...keyword_element.column]
          expression = cop.send(:to_modifier_form, node)
          cop.send(:line_length, "#{code_before}#{expression}#{cop.send(:code_after, node)}")
        end

        def self.to_modifier_form_for(cop, node)
          body = cop.send(:if_body_source, node.body)
          expression = [body, node.keyword, node.condition.source].compact.join(' ')
          parenthesized = cop.send(:parenthesize?, node) ? "(#{expression})" : expression
          [parenthesized, cop.send(:first_line_comment, node)].compact.join(' ')
        end

        def self.if_body_source_for(cop, if_body)
          if if_body.call_type? &&
             if_body.last_argument&.hash_type? && if_body.last_argument.pairs.last&.value_omission?
            "#{cop.send(:method_source, if_body)}(#{if_body.arguments.map(&:source).join(', ')})"
          else
            if_body.source
          end
        end

        def self.method_source_for(if_body)
          end_range = if_body.implicit_call? ? if_body.loc.dot.end : if_body.loc.selector

          if_body.source_range.begin.join(end_range).source
        end

        def self.first_line_comment_for(cop, node)
          comment = cop.processed_source.comments.find { |c| cop.send(:same_line?, c, node) }
          return unless comment

          comment_source = comment.source
          comment_source unless cop.send(:comment_disables_cop?, comment_source)
        end

        def self.code_after_for(_cop, node)
          end_element = node.loc.end
          code = end_element.source_line[end_element.last_column..]
          code unless code.empty?
        end

        def self.parenthesize_for(node)
          parent = node.parent
          return false if parent.nil?
          return true if parent.assignment? || parent.operator_keyword?
          return true if %i[array pair].include?(parent.type)

          node.parent.send_type?
        end

        def self.max_line_length_for(cop)
          return unless cop.config.for_cop('Layout/LineLength')['Enabled']

          cop.config.for_cop('Layout/LineLength')['Max']
        end

        def self.comment_disables_cop_for?(cop, comment)
          regexp_pattern = "# rubocop : (disable|todo) ([^,],)* (all|#{cop.cop_name})"
          Regexp.new(regexp_pattern.gsub(' ', '\s*')).match?(comment)
        end

        def self.empty_begin_condition?(node)
          node && node.type == :begin && node.children.empty?
        end

        def self.setter_method_call?(node)
          node && node.call_type? && node.setter_method?
        end

        def self.safe_assignment_node?(node)
          return false unless node && node.begin_type? && node.children.one?

          child = node.children.first
          child.equals_asgn? || setter_method_call?(child)
        end

        end

        def self.single_negative?(node)
          return false unless node && node.send_type? && node.method?(:!)

          receiver = node.receiver
          return false if receiver && receiver.send_type? && receiver.method?(:!)

Implemented the `Style/GuardClause` safety fix.

- `Style/GuardClause` now skips offenses when a local variable assigned anywhere in the condition is referenced in either branch. This prevents unsafe autocorrection of cases such as `(a = b).positive?` followed by `return a`.
- Added a regression spec for assignment nested in a predicate condition.
